crisis.title: Safety Support
intro: You deserve support that keeps you safe.
If you are in immediate danger or feel at risk, you need real human help right now.
Mani cannot provide emergency care — but Mani can guide you to the right place.

guidance.label: If you need to talk to someone
guidance.body: Reach out to a trusted person in your life. A real conversation can help you stay grounded.

guidance.label: If you need professional support
guidance.body: Use one of the helplines below. These are confidential and available at all hours.

crisis.disclaimer: Mani offers emotional support and simple tools to help you sort what you're feeling. It does not replace medical, psychiatric, or crisis intervention services.
